demo_store_requirements_gap.requirement: Demo stores must be distinct Client Transfer development stores
demo_store_requirements_gap.detail: Currently only 1 development store (tema-qkqpke0j.myshopify.com) exists with 4 theme IDs. Shopify requires 3 public demo stores for Sartorial, Edition, and Archive, each with distinct catalogs and URLs.

demo_store_requirements_gap.requirement: Test payment gateway or Bogus Gateway enabled
demo_store_requirements_gap.detail: Bogus Gateway is not enabled on tema-qkqpke0j.myshopify.com (store checkout requires real payment / password).

demo_store_requirements_gap.requirement: No password protection on demo stores
demo_store_requirements_gap.detail: Storefront password is enabled because development stores cannot disable password without transfer or active plan.

demo_store_requirements_gap.requirement: Authentic, high-quality photography with valid commercial licenses
demo_store_requirements_gap.detail: Images used in demo catalog (Serra coat, Nove blazer, etc.) must have confirmed commercial licenses on file.
